access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a dark velvet dinner dress by Rouff: a black bolero worked in jet beads over a lace front and collar, a wide sash at the waist, the skirt in ribbed velvet to a banded hem. A real garment, French, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): jet and evening dress.
what_it_supplies: jet beading on a dark bodice, a lace front and a wide sash, for evening dress
what_it_does_not_supply: how any Prairie Avenue woman dressed, or the colour of any dress she owned
how often such a dress was worn on a Chicago street in 1904
